title: Step 1 - How to Preprocess Data for Artificial Neural Networks in R

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: I'm super excited to be in the deep learning part.
cues.zh: 很高興進入深度學習部分。

cues.en: This is one of the most fascinating and exciting branch of machine learning, and besides it's one of the most powerful.
cues.zh: 這是機器學習中最迷人、最令人期待的分支之一，而且也是最強大的分支之一。

cues.en: In the following tutorials, we're gonna solve the business problem described by Kirill at the beginning of this section.
cues.zh: 接下來幾堂課，要解決 Kirill 在本章開頭介紹的商業問題。

cues.en: And you will see that we're going to get strong results thanks to this artificial neural network that we are about to build with R.
cues.zh: 你會看到，用 R 建立的人工神經網路將帶來很好的結果。

cues.en: So as usual, we are gonna make this artificial neural network model very efficiently, and we're gonna use the best package for that, which I will let you find out about in the next tutorials.
cues.zh: 照慣例，會用高效率的方式建立模型，並使用最適合的套件，下一堂再揭曉。

cues.en: So let's start.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: And the first step of our journey is the boring step, data pre-processing.
cues.zh: 旅程第一步，是比較無聊的資料前處理。

cues.en: But we will do it very efficiently because we have our template, our classification template that I've prepared here.
cues.zh: 不過有範本，所以可以很快完成。我已經把分類範本準備在這裡。

cues.en: And why can we use this classification template?
cues.zh: 為什麼能用分類範本？

cues.en: Well, it's by nature of the business problem.
cues.zh: 因為這個商業問題的本質就是分類。

cues.en: You saw in the business problem description that you have some independent variables.
cues.zh: 問題說明裡有一些自變數，

cues.en: And with these independent variables, you have to predict a dependent variable that has a binary outcome.
cues.zh: 要用這些自變數，預測具有二元結果的應變數。

cues.en: And since the outcome of the dependent variable is binary, that means it's a categorical variable.
cues.zh: 應變數的結果是二元，就表示它是類別變數。

cues.en: That means we have to predict classes zero and one, and therefore that makes our problem a classification problem.
cues.zh: 也就是要預測 0 與 1 兩個類別，所以屬於分類問題。

cues.en: And so, okay, we are going to build a deep learning model but this deep learning model is going to be nothing else than a classification model.
cues.zh: 雖然要建立深度學習模型，但這個模型的用途仍然是分類。

cues.en: And that's why we are gonna use our classification template that we have here and that will save us a lot of time to build our artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 所以可以使用這裡的分類範本，省下很多建立神經網路的時間。

cues.en: And besides, we wanna focus on the deep learning model itself.
cues.zh: 而且我們希望把重點放在深度學習模型本身。

cues.en: So we will get there very quickly thanks to this template.
cues.zh: 透過範本，很快就能進入那個階段。

cues.en: All right, so let's take everything from this template from the top down to here, because we cannot use this section here, because, you know,
cues.zh: 先複製範本從最上方到這裡的所有內容，下面這個部分不能用，因為

cues.en: this is the section to visualize the training set results and the test set results as well.
cues.zh: 這裡是訓練集與測試集結果的視覺化。

cues.en: But only when we have two independent variables, because one independent variable corresponds to one dimension.
cues.zh: 只有兩個自變數時才方便使用，因為每個自變數對應一個維度。

cues.en: And since now, in the data set of the business problem, we have I think 10 or 11 independent variables.
cues.zh: 但這次商業問題的資料集，我記得有 10 或 11 個自變數。

cues.en: Well, then it's a little bit hard to represent something in 11 dimensions.
cues.zh: 要畫出 11 維的內容，就有點困難。

cues.en: So we won't take this, but we will definitely take everything that's above.
cues.zh: 所以不複製這段，但上面的內容全部取用。

cues.en: So I'm going to copy that and let's go back to our ANN model and paste this classification template right here.
cues.zh: 複製後，回到 ANN 模型，把分類範本貼在這裡。

cues.en: All right, and now in this template, we're gonna change a very few things.
cues.zh: 現在只要修改少數幾個地方。

cues.en: And of course we are gonna build our artificial neural network right here in this section, "Create your classifier here."
cues.zh: 當然，人工神經網路會建立在 Create your classifier here 這一節。

cues.en: We can already replace "classifier here" by ANN to then build the model.
cues.zh: 可以先把 classifier here 改成 ANN，等一下再建立模型。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: But, of course, we need to make sure everything's okay in all the data pre-processing step, and that's what we're gonna do right now.
cues.zh: 不過要先確認資料前處理每一步都正確，現在就來做。

cues.en: All right, so let's start.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's start with the basic step, setting the right folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 先做基本步驟，把正確資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: So right now I'm on my desktop.
cues.zh: 現在位於桌面。

cues.en: I'm going to my machine learning (indistinct) folder.
cues.zh: 進入 Machine Learning 資料夾。

cues.en: Then we are in part eight, deep learning.
cues.zh: 再進第八部分 Deep Learning。

cues.en: And now section 40 artificial neural networks.
cues.zh: 接著是第 40 節 Artificial Neural Networks。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 到了。

cues.en: Make sure that you have the Churn_Modeling.csv file and if that's the case, you can click on this more button here, and then set as working directory.
cues.zh: 確認有 Churn_Modelling.csv。如果有，就按 More，選 Set As Working Directory。

cues.en: Great, and now let's change a few things.
cues.zh: 很好，接著改幾個地方。

cues.en: So first of all, let's start with this section, importing the data set.
cues.zh: 先從匯入資料集這一節開始。

cues.en: While the name of the data set is not social network ads, it's now Churn_Modeling.
cues.zh: 資料集檔名不再是 Social_Network_Ads，現在是 Churn_Modelling。

cues.en: All right, we are now ready to import the data set.
cues.zh: 可以匯入資料集了。

cues.en: So let's do it right now.
cues.zh: 現在執行。

cues.en: I'm going to select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這一行並執行。

cues.en: All right, data set well imported.
cues.zh: 成功匯入資料集。

cues.en: Well, we have actually 14 variables, but let's see if we include all these variables in the real data set, you know, the one on which we want to build our deep learning model.
cues.zh: 目前有 14 個變數，不過要確認建立深度學習模型時，是否真的全部使用。

cues.en: So let's see, I'm going to click on this data set here to see which independent variables we include in the model.
cues.zh: 按這裡的資料集，看看模型應包含哪些自變數。

cues.en: All right, so just a quick reminder, this data set contains 10,000 observations containing some informations of customers in a bank, like the surname, the credit score, geography, gender, age,
cues.zh: 快速提醒，這份資料有 10,000 筆觀測值，包含銀行客戶的姓氏、信用評分、所在地、性別、年齡，

cues.en: and all the other informations here.
cues.zh: 以及這裡的其他資訊。

cues.en: And during six months, the bank looked, for each customer, if the customer stayed or left the bank within the six months period.
cues.zh: 銀行在六個月內，觀察每位客戶是否留下或離開。

cues.en: And this result, whether the customer stayed or left, is given in this last column here, exited.
cues.zh: 結果記錄在最後的 Exited 欄位。

cues.en: So one means that the customer left the bank during the six months, and zero means that the customer stayed in the bank during the six months.
cues.zh: 1 代表六個月內離開，0 代表六個月內仍然留下。

cues.en: So what's important to understand now is that all these variables here from row number to estimated salary are the independent variables.
cues.zh: 現在要了解，從 RowNumber 到 EstimatedSalary 的這些欄位，都是自變數。

cues.en: And the last column here, exited, is the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 最後的 Exited 則是應變數。

cues.en: So right now our goal is to make a model where we can predict this result, exited, here, whether the customer left or stayed in the bank,
cues.zh: 我們的目標是建立模型，預測 Exited，也就是客戶會離開還是留下，

cues.en: from the information contained in all these independent variables here.
cues.zh: 根據的就是這些自變數中的資訊。

cues.en: But the thing is that in these independent variables, some definitely don't have an impact on this independent variable. exited.
cues.zh: 不過，其中有些自變數顯然不會影響 Exited。

cues.en: And so now what we have to do is only take the independent variables that could have an impact and correlations with the decision of the customer to leave or stay in the bank.
cues.zh: 所以只選可能與客戶留下或離開有關、具有相關性的自變數。

cues.en: And so that's what we're gonna do right now.
cues.zh: 現在就來做。

cues.en: So let's look at each of these independent variables, one by one, and let's see which one we keep in our model.
cues.zh: 逐一檢查每個自變數，看看要保留哪些。

cues.en: All right, so let's start with the first one, row number.
cues.zh: 先從第一個 RowNumber 開始。

cues.en: Well, row number has definitely no impact on the dependent variable, exited, so of course we will not include it.
cues.zh: 列編號顯然不影響 Exited，所以不納入。

cues.en: Then customer ID.
cues.zh: 再來是 CustomerId。

cues.en: Well, customer ID, that's the same.
cues.zh: 客戶 ID 也一樣。

cues.en: That's just an identification number.
cues.zh: 只是識別號碼。

cues.en: This definitely doesn't have any impact on the decision of the customer to stay or leave in the bank.
cues.zh: 不會影響客戶留下或離開銀行的決定。

cues.en: So we will not include that either.
cues.zh: 所以同樣排除。

cues.en: Then the surname, well, that's the same.
cues.zh: 姓氏也是如此。

cues.en: It's not because your name is Andrews that you have more chance to leave the bank, than if your name is Romeo.
cues.zh: 不會因為姓 Andrews，就比姓 Romeo 更容易離開銀行。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: So we don't include surname either.
cues.zh: 因此不納入 Surname。

cues.en: But then we have credit score.
cues.zh: 接著是 CreditScore。

cues.en: And credit score might have an impact on the decision of the customer to stay or leave in the bank.
cues.zh: 信用評分可能影響客戶留下或離開的決定。

cues.en: Indeed, we can assume that customers with a low credit score are more likely to leave the bank than customers with a high credit score.
cues.zh: 例如可以假設，信用評分低的客戶，比評分高的客戶更容易流失。

cues.en: So definitely we will include credit score in our model.
cues.zh: 所以會把 CreditScore 納入模型。

cues.en: All right, then we have geography.
cues.zh: 再來是 Geography。

cues.en: Well, maybe some customers are more likely to leave the bank in one specific country, and that can be due to external factors, like the economy of the country or any other factors.
cues.zh: 某個國家的客戶可能更容易離開，原因可能是國家經濟或其他外部因素。

cues.en: But yes, definitely there might be some correlations between the countries and the decision to stay or leave the bank.
cues.zh: 國家與客戶留下或離開之間，確實可能存在關聯。

cues.en: So we will include that as well.
cues.zh: 所以也納入。

cues.en: Then gender, well, that's the same.
cues.zh: Gender 也一樣。

cues.en: Maybe men or women are more likely to stay in the bank than the other, so we need to check it out.
cues.zh: 男性或女性可能有不同的留存傾向，需要檢查。

cues.en: Then age, well, that's the same and that's even quite intuitive.
cues.zh: Age 也是如此，而且相當直覺。

cues.en: We might expect that younger people are more likely to leave the bank than older people, because older people have more balance and have more stability.
cues.zh: 可能預期年輕人比年長者更容易離開，因為年長者餘額較多，也較穩定。

cues.en: So we include age as well.
cues.zh: 所以納入 Age。

cues.en: Then tenure, so tenure is for how long the customer has been in the bank.
cues.zh: Tenure 則是客戶與銀行往來多久。

cues.en: And so that's the same.
cues.zh: 同樣地，

cues.en: We might expect that customers that have been in the bank for a long time are more likely to stay in the bank than recent customers.
cues.zh: 可能預期往來時間長的客戶，比新客戶更容易留下。

cues.en: So yes, we'll take it.
cues.zh: 所以也保留。

cues.en: Then balance, well, balance, of course, we might expect that this customer with this high balance has a lot more chance to stay in the bank than this customer with a zero balance.
cues.zh: 再來是 Balance，當然可能預期餘額高的這位客戶，比餘額為 0 的客戶更容易留下。

cues.en: All right, then the number of products, so that's the number of banking products the customers have in the bank.
cues.zh: 接著是 NumOfProducts，代表客戶使用多少項銀行產品。

cues.en: And so of course, maybe that the customers with many products in the bank are more likely to stay than customers with, for example, one product in the bank.
cues.zh: 使用多項產品的客戶，可能比只使用一項產品的客戶更容易留下。

cues.en: So we'll need to check it out.
cues.zh: 因此需要確認。

cues.en: That's just assumptions.
cues.zh: 這些目前都只是推測。

cues.en: That's the model that we'll find out about these correlations more thoroughly.
cues.zh: 模型會更深入地找出這些關聯。

cues.en: But you know, definitely from our intuition, we need to include number of products as well.
cues.zh: 但從直覺來看，產品數也應該納入。

cues.en: Then has credit card.
cues.zh: 接著是 HasCrCard。

cues.en: Well, that's a little bit of the same as this variable.
cues.zh: 和剛才的變數有點類似。

cues.en: Customers that have a credit card might be more likely to stay in the bank than customers that don't have a credit card, so yes.
cues.zh: 持有信用卡的客戶，可能比沒有信用卡的客戶更容易留下，所以保留。

cues.en: Is active member, that's the same.
cues.zh: IsActiveMember 也一樣。

cues.en: If a customer is active, than this customer is more likely to stay in the bank than a customer that is not active.
cues.zh: 活躍的客戶，可能比不活躍的客戶更容易留下。

cues.en: So, yes, that might be a significant independent variable.
cues.zh: 所以它可能是重要的自變數。

cues.en: Then estimated salary, well, that's the salary of the customer estimated by the bank.
cues.zh: 最後 EstimatedSalary，是銀行估計的客戶薪資。

cues.en: And it would make sense that customers with a high estimated salary have more chance to leave the bank than customers with a low estimated salary.
cues.zh: 預期高薪資客戶可能比低薪資客戶更容易離開，也有其道理。

cues.en: All right, so that was the last independent variable of this data set.
cues.zh: 這就是資料集最後一個自變數。

cues.en: So now we know which independent variables we include in our data set, and that's what we're going to specify right now by updating our data set, taking only the indexes of the independent variables
cues.zh: 現在知道要納入哪些自變數，接著更新資料集，只選取模型需要的自變數

cues.en: we want to include in the model.
cues.zh: 所對應的索引。

cues.en: So let's see what these indexes are.
cues.zh: 來看看這些索引。

cues.en: Okay, so indexes in R start at one.
cues.zh: R 的索引從 1 開始。

cues.en: And so basically we're taking all the independent variables from credit score up to estimated salary.
cues.zh: 基本上，要取 CreditScore 到 EstimatedSalary 的所有自變數。

cues.en: So let's see, index one, index two, index three, index four.
cues.zh: 看看這裡，索引 1、2、3、4。

cues.en: So we are taking the indexes 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13.
All right, so we are are taking the indexes from 4 to 14, because you know in R it's not like in Python when we separate a matrix of features and the dependent variable vector,
cues.zh: 不過實際要選 4 到 14，因為 R 與 Python 不同，這裡不把特徵矩陣與應變數向量分開，

cues.en: we include all the variables in one data frame.
cues.zh: 而是把所有變數放在同一個 DataFrame。

cues.en: And so we include the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 所以也要包含應變數。

cues.en: Great, so let's input these indexes.
cues.zh: 把這些索引填進去。

cues.en: So we just said that we want to take the indexes from 4, so that's the index of the first independent variable, up to the index 14,
cues.zh: 剛才說從第一個自變數的索引 4，一直到索引 14，

cues.en: which is the index of the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 也就是應變數的索引。

cues.en: And that's great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now we can update our data set by selecting this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這一行並執行，就會更新資料集。

cues.en: Great, and now, as you can see, if I, well, go back to the dataset here, we have all our potentially statistically significant, independent variables that might have an impact
cues.zh: 回到資料集，可以看到保留了所有可能具有統計顯著性、可能影響

cues.en: on the dependent variable, exited.
cues.zh: Exited 應變數的自變數。

cues.en: And so now the first step of data pre-processing is completed.
cues.zh: 資料前處理第一步完成。

cues.en: We imported correctly the dataset by choosing all the relevant independent variables.
cues.zh: 正確匯入資料，也選出所有相關自變數。

cues.en: Okay, and now let's move on to the second step.
cues.zh: 接著進入第二步。

cues.en: The second step is encoding the target feature as factor.
cues.zh: 第二步原本是把目標特徵編碼成 factor。

cues.en: Well, we don't really need to do that because the dependent variable of our data set is a categorical variable with a binary outcome, one or zero.
cues.zh: 這裡其實不需要，因為應變數本來就是結果為 1 或 0 的二元類別變數。

cues.en: And the thing to understand is that the package we're gonna use is going to recognize it as a categorical variable with a binary outcome.
cues.zh: 要了解的是，接下來使用的套件會把它辨識為二元類別變數。

cues.en: So we actually don't need to encode this target feature exited as factor.
cues.zh: 所以不必把 Exited 這個目標特徵再編成 factor。

cues.en: So I'm going to remove this line, we don't need it.
cues.zh: 這一行就移除，不需要。

cues.en: However, we do need to do something regarding some categorical variables.
cues.zh: 但針對其他類別變數，仍有一些事情要做。

cues.en: Of course, I'm talking about the two categorical independent variables we have in our data set.
cues.zh: 當然是指資料集中的兩個類別自變數。

cues.en: And these two variables are, of course, geography and gender.
cues.zh: 就是 Geography 與 Gender。

cues.en: So we have two problems here.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩件事要處理。

cues.en: So we need to do two things here for these variables.
cues.zh: 所以需要對這兩個變數做兩個步驟。

cues.en: The first thing we need to do is to convert them as factors, and then we will need to do something more than we used to do when encoding our categorical variables.
cues.zh: 第一步轉成 factor，再進一步做以前類別編碼沒有做的處理。

cues.en: It's to set them as numeric.
cues.zh: 也就是轉成 numeric。

cues.en: And to do this, we'll use the as.numeric function.
cues.zh: 使用 as.numeric 函式。

cues.en: And why do we need to do this, especially here?
cues.zh: 為什麼這裡特別需要？

cues.en: Well, that is just because the deep learning package that we're gonna use is requiring it, and that's the only reason.
cues.zh: 只是因為接下來使用的深度學習套件要求這種格式，唯一原因就是這個。

cues.en: It expects factors but set as numeric, numeric factors.
cues.zh: 它預期的是以數值表示的 factor。

cues.en: So, let's do this.
cues.zh: 來處理吧。

cues.en: I'm going back to my ANN model.
cues.zh: 回到 ANN 模型。

cues.en: And so first we're going to change this to say that we're encoding the categorical variables as factors.
cues.zh: 先修改這段標題，表示要把類別變數編碼成 factor。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And now, we're gonna take this categorical data R file that we made in part one data pre-processing, because you know there is the code ready to encode any categorical data.
cues.zh: 接著取用第一部分資料前處理建立的 categorical_data.R，裡面已經有類別資料編碼程式。

cues.en: So I'm going to select all this and paste it here in this second step of data pre-processing to encode the categorical variables as factors.
cues.zh: 選取內容，貼到第二步，把類別變數編碼成 factor。

cues.en: All right, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: We just need to replace the names of the variables and then add this as.numeric function to set the factors as numeric.
